versions.changelog:
Initial release of jd-description-writer – a professional job description (JD) writing assistant.

- Generates precise, professional, and compelling job descriptions based on job title and recruitment requirements.
- Covers three core modules: Job Responsibilities, Qualifications, and Key Skills.
- Follows strict structure and concise writing principles to ensure clarity and competitiveness.
- Allows integration of company and salary information into JDs when provided.
- Designed for use in various recruitment scenarios to attract suitable candidates.
